title: Fancy Yellow Radiant — Two-Tone
subtitle: 10.04 ct Fancy Yellow radiant · half-moon sides · micro-pavé band

stone.origin: Centre: 10.04 ct Fancy Yellow radiant-cut diamond. Two white half-moon side stones.

metal: 18K yellow gold (centre prongs) + Platinum (surround, side settings & band)
description: A 10.04-carat Fancy Yellow radiant in yellow gold double-claw prongs, flanked by two white half-moon diamonds. Micro-pavé diamond band. Two-tone setting — warm gold holds the colour at the seat, cool platinum frames it from outside. Ref C0878.
editorial: A Fancy Yellow radiant at ten carats crosses a threshold. This one sits at 10.04 — just past the line — in yellow gold double-claw prongs that exist for one reason: to hold warmth at the seat of a warm stone. The surround is platinum. The half-moon white side stones are set in platinum. The micro-pavé band runs in platinum down the shank. Two temperatures in one ring, pulling in opposite directions, meeting exactly where the Fancy Yellow sits. The stone chose the metal. The metal chose the geometry.
